name: fight_act1_gith_patrol
title: Act 1 fight: the githyanki patrol at the Mountain Pass
task: Win the fight: defeat the githyanki patrol.
scored_by: Passed the first moment a fight is won (a combat that ends with the enemies beaten and the party standing; the one ahead of you is the fight). Nothing else counts toward the score: party members downed or killed, game time and cost are reported next to it.
about: Fight (family 1), small and elite: a githyanki patrol of a few strong warriors and casters. claude-run-2 S023 nearly wiped and reloaded once; it won only after a full rest and Hold Person. Start save: no long rest (camp supplies 35 of 40 are too few), full HP, one level-2 spell slot spent; Wyll is at camp.

note.where: The Mountain Pass, on the road ahead of a githyanki patrol, out of combat.

character.name: Tav
character.brief: A half-orc paladin (Oath of Devotion), once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant.
